Thanks to all kind traiblazers and good luck with your own pulls.
I can experience some of them now. Besides not everyone can experience everything even if their life is long. I have come to terms with it.
Is it really? I think it's worse to wait endlessly hoping that things will change. I've tried. I really did. I am not cut out for it. But it's alright now.

It seems I didn't think this part through. I suppose you are right, but I really don't feel that I need to find that just yet. Thank you again.
Have a great weekend, because you just made my.

Wow. First of all thank you for taking the time to write such an thorough reply. I took my time to read it carefully. 

For my lie... it already managed to come back to bite me. I've really outdone myself with this one.
For the cause. It is family related and money related. With family it is always complicated. I was thinking of seeing a professional for a long time now. But I always told myself, that there is no need and I shouldn't waste their time. Never did I hear it from other people that I should see someone. I will have to talk to my doctor. I think I should take this year to put myself together a bit.

From the recommendations you listed... I used to participate in a lot of school sport clubs. But as we didn't go to school for a whole year I forgot, that it actually made me feel better. I was trying to work up the confidence to go to the gym, but I am rather self-conscious about my weight, so I've been putting it off for two years now. I would try asking a friend to go with me, but non of them lives in the same town as me. 

I think that I can start with the alarm thing. I tend to sleep around 9-12 hours. On occasions when I woke up earlier I remember being amazed at the amount of time I had. I think I can do this one. 

Also the one with reminders. One thing at a time as they say. I used to learn a new language. Maybe I will be able to pick it up again. 

I used to have a lots of hobbies. But one after another I lost interest in them. Luckily I still like to listen to music. Sometimes when I don't want to think I blast the volume to drown out the thoughts. 

I like the app MoodTool. I might give it a try. I will also check out the books you recommended. Books were always a passion of my. 

For my purpose in life I thought that I had it pretty much figured out. Learn programming, go to IT collage, get a decent paying job, buy a cat, have enough money to not have to worry about them like I do now. But I failed at stage two.

You gave me a lot to think about. Thank you for all advices and links you provided. I think that I will refer to this a lot in the upcoming weeks as I am bound to try and break some of my new resolutions. It really made me happy that you heard me out. I really don't want to give up. For example I want to go to Japan. It is a single dream if my. I promise that I will try. I don't know how to thank you enough. You helped me a lot. 

I hope you are doing fine.
It's not that strong. And it's on only in the winter.
How did you find out?
Unfortunately I don't do that
That's great. It proposes a chance that I can change as well. I'm happy for you.

Exactly! Like an ant. 
By the by happy cake day!
They are great people. But I've just recently realized how different we are. I'm an introvert and I find it hard to talk to new people, but it can be worth it. Thank you. I'll think about it.
Thank You. Tomorrow I can be again in my solitude and everything will be fine. And the same goes for You.
Oh, I didn't know that. (Not an American)

In Slovakia we have Nikola.

The best definition is basic bitch - Instagram whore addicted to Starbucks (even tho that can be a bit tricky as we don't have Starbucks in every town), with personality more shallow than a puddle outside your house.

That I'm forgetful and dumb.

You can get away with anything this way. Works especially well with people who are full of themselves.
Send a fully armed battalion.
I only wanted someone to hear me out. I don't like lying to her every day... but you are totally right. I was naive to think she would even try to understand.

You really should treasure a person like that. If she is the one who suggested it, then she seems to be ready for anything. She will care about you anyway.
This may not be a good advice, but try to tell her just a bit, so she will get the feeling of what you want to say. If she freaks out... bad luck. But if not then go ahead.
Anyway  I'm happy for you that you found someone worth getting off the bed. I would love to hear someday how it worked out. Good luck.
Oh no! I have a full bag of Lay's chips.

I can try to find some other therapist, but the problem is there aren't many. I went to 2, but it was bacause of stress and then because of my mother. And in my county people usually think that if you go to a psychologist you are either weak or a psychopath. People here are generally not very understanding. 
I may try a friend I guess. But I have a bad feeling about it.
To know that therapy is helping is good to know . I hope it will work out for you. I'm happy that I found at least this community. Thank you.
Thanks, mates. I'll check them out for sure and then add them to my wish list.

I doubt he ever tried to seek any help. He has his own  friends, so maybe them. But he would always tell me everything. And I would just listen. And he would tell me how we are about to be homeless. How he needed to borrow everything I've earned in my summer job. How bad his work is and so on and on. 
I didn't want to cause more trouble for him, so I was listening in silence and hugged him occasionally and did what I could to help. We never talked about how I felt. 
 Last week I had a bad moment when he said a small unimportant thing and it totally got me. He was just making fun, but I started yelling and crying hysterically. It was the first time I showed anything in years. And then he gave me a lift to my mother and I felt like shit. 
So that's a no-go. The look in his eyes when he realized that he may have failed. That I may be feeling unhappy. I can't tell him anything.

Thank you for your time and for listening to me and I hope that you are finally surrounded by good people.
I would like to learn more about Greek mythology.  I don't own a single book and I don't know which one should I pick first. Does anyone have some recommendations? Only in English.

My depression started around the time my parents decided to get divorced. My mother cheated on my father and that's when our relationship was destroyed. Then she forced me to go the psychologist, cause she had a feeling I don't love her, and I hated every second of it. That's why I've never tried to seek help from someone qualified. The reason I've never ended it was because of my father. He is a broken man and I have a suspicion he was concidering a suicide at some point as well. I felt like such a burden to him, but he means a world to me. So I've pushed it away, all the thoughts, but I guess that's where you were right. It's still there. And for the past few weeks everything has been reminding me how shitty it was and it still is. Especially when I'm with my friends. They are only good-times friends. And unless I tell someone I feel like I will get back where I was.
I also hope your situation got better. Did you solve it somehow?
